description: Test prompts that verify rdk-multimedia triggers and produces correct, board-aware low-level multimedia guidance (hardware codec, capture, scale, display) the way a real RDK developer would phrase them in Chinese. Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: ffmpeg-software-encode-trap
evals.prompt: 我在 RDK X5 上用 ffmpeg 编码 H.264，CPU 直接占满了，怎么搞成硬件编码？
evals.expected_output: Identifies ffmpeg as software encoding, routes to the VPU via sp_dev / HB_VENC, and suggests proving it with a demo.

assertions.text: Says ffmpeg defaults to a software encoder, which is why the CPU is pinned.
Routes to the hardware VPU via sp_dev (sp_start_encode / SP_ENCODER_H264) or HB_VENC, not ffmpeg thread tuning.
Mentions proving the hardware path with a demo such as vio2encoder in /app/cdev_demo/.

evals.name: vps-channels-upscale
evals.prompt: X 系的 VPS 一个 IPU 能输出几路？哪一路能放大？
evals.expected_output: 7 channels chn0-chn6; chn5 is the only upscale channel (max 1.5x); chn0-4 downscale.

assertions.text: States the VPS has 7 output channels (chn0-chn6).
States chn5 is the only channel that can upscale (and that it is limited, ~1.5x).
States chn0-chn4 are downscale (and does not claim arbitrary upscale on any channel).

evals.name: s600-vpu-multicore-u-flag
evals.prompt: S600 编解码示例里的 -u 参数是干嘛的？为什么在 S100 上不生效？
evals.expected_output: -u selects the VPU core id (0/1/2); only S600 has multiple VPU cores, so -u is S600-only.

assertions.text: Explains -u selects the VPU core id (values 0/1/2, default 0).
States only S600 has multiple VPU cores, so -u only takes effect on S600 (not S100/S100P).
Does NOT claim S100 has multiple VPU cores.

evals.name: encode-stride-alignment
evals.prompt: 我编码 H.264 报尺寸/stride 错误，我的图像是 1920x1082，怎么回事？
evals.expected_output: Height 1082 is not 8-byte aligned; align W/H to 8 (stride to 32) or crop with VIDEO_CROP_INFO_S.

assertions.text: Explains H.264/H.265 require width and height 8-byte aligned (and stride 32-byte aligned), so 1082 is invalid.
Recommends aligning to 1080 (or an 8-aligned height) or cropping with VIDEO_CROP_INFO_S.
Does NOT suggest blindly resubmitting the same unaligned frame to the encoder.

evals.name: s-series-not-vot
evals.prompt: 我在 S600 上想用 HB_VOT 把画面输出到屏幕，怎么初始化 VOT？
evals.expected_output: S-series has no HB_VOT; display goes through IDE/IDU and MIPI DSI / MIPI CSI2 Device. Correct the wrong stack.

assertions.text: Says the S-series does not have HB_VOT / the X-series VOT stack.
States S-series display uses IDE/IDU, output via MIPI DSI or MIPI CSI2 Device.
Does NOT invent HB_VOT initialization steps for the S600.
